subject: MAP: Activation velocity — onramp playbook for environment handoff
messages:
From: maya_srinivasan <maya@redwood.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice@edgehealth.com>
Date: 2026-12-10T09:05:00-08:00
Subject: MAP: Activation velocity — onramp playbook for environment handoff

Hi Alice,

Thanks for the time yesterday. Per our mutual-action plan (MAP) discussion, I put together a short onramp sprint we can run to get EdgeHealth's POC environment production-like and ready for evaluation. Goal is to have a stable test tenant with keys, org setup, and network gates in place within two weeks so your ML team can start throughput and latency checks.

High-level sprint (proposed):
- Day 0 (today): Confirm owners + sign MAP
- Day 1–2: Org seed + service account creation (EdgeHealth)
- Day 3–5: API key issuance + ephemeral key walk-through (Redwood)
- Day 6–9: IP allowlist and VPC peering setup (EdgeHealth + infra)
- Day 10–14: Validation, smoke tests, and handoff to evaluation team

Immediate asks for us to proceed:
1) List of CIDR ranges to add to allowlist (or a ticket link for peering).
2) Primary org admin user and an ops contact for peering.
3) Approval to issue a scoped API seed for evaluation (we will rotate keys after the POC).

I attached a draft MAP workbook with ownership rows and an initial timeline (redwood-map-draft.xlsx). Please review and tell me who should be the org owner on your side so we can lock the timeline.

If you're good, I'll loop in Neha (infra) and Prioym (solutions) to capture technical requirements and schedule the first 30-minute handoff.

Thanks,
Maya Srinivasan
Senior Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
maya@redwood.com
[Attachment: redwood-map-draft.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

I'll review the MAP workbook and give feedback by end of day.

Hi Alice / DevOps,

Thanks for the quick turn. I'm Neha (infra ops) — I'll own the peering/allowlist work from Redwood's side. To answer your questions:

1) Minimal allowlist sample (outbound from EdgeHealth to Redwood):
- IPs/hostnames: 
  - outbound.ephemeral.redwood-inference.net (TLS 443) — we prefer hostnames for HA, but sample IPs for firewall teams below
  - 34.201.12.45 (us-east egress LB)
  - 52.204.9.130 (us-west egress LB)
- Ports: 443 outbound (TLS) and 80 for health checks if your firewall team requires it (rare).

2) Peering approval window: typically 24–72 business hours on our side after we receive the request + completed peering form. If you can open the ticket and provide your VPC IDs and CIDRs we will prioritize it and provide a peering acceptance ETA in the ticket.

3) VPC peering prerequisites (short checklist):
- Your VPC ID and account ID
- Peer CIDR(s) and route acceptance preferences
- Contact for peering ops (we'll need an L2 to triage connectivity)

Attachments attached: vpc-peering-reqs.pdf (template) and api-seed-instructions.txt (how we issue scoped seeds).

I'll schedule a 30-minute handoff for tomorrow 10am PT unless you propose otherwise.

Cheers,
Neha Kapoor
Infrastructure Engineer | Redwood Inference
neha@redwood.com
[Attachment: vpc-peering-reqs.pdf (PDF)]
[Attachment: api-seed-instructions.txt (text)]

— Alice
